description: This file defines Express.js routes for session tracking data management, including listing, retrieving by ID, creating, updating, deleting, and generating duration histograms with caching and data normalization.

methods.name: toNumber
methods.description: Converts various representations of numbers, including Decimal128 and string, to plain JavaScript numbers, returning NaN if parsing fails.

methods.name: normalizeSessionDoc
methods.description: Normalizes session document fields to ensure numeric values are properly parsed and defaulted, especially total_cost, cost_history[].total_cost, and agent_costs.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Retrieves cached data for session duration histograms, considering TTL expiration.

methods.name: setCache
methods.description: Stores data in cache with an expiration timestamp for session duration histograms.

methods.name: buildCacheKey
methods.description: Creates a deterministic cache key string based on histogram query parameters.

methods.name: computePercentiles
methods.description: Calculates statistical percentiles (median, p90, p95) along with min, max, and count for a numeric array.

methods.name: parseHistogramParams
methods.description: Validates and parses query parameters for the duration histogram endpoint, including scope, userId, tenantId, start/end dates, and bin size.

methods.name: buildMatchFilter
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB filter object for session duration histogram queries based on scope, userId, tenantId, status, and date range.

methods.name: buildBinsFromGroups
methods.description: Transforms aggregation group results into histogram bins with start, end, and count.
